svg.text: Fleet Pi — chat data schema (Neon · jolly-lab-20094853 · public.pi_* mirror + neon_auth identity)

g.text: Held private: no views expose neon_auth
to Data API roles; never RLS-enabled.
pi_* rows link to neon_auth.user.id only
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UNIQ unique · dashed border = non-app / ledger table · → = FK / ownership edge (arrowhead = child side)
Source of truth: Pi JSONL session files. These mirror tables are derived projections; mirror failures are non-fatal and must never block chat streaming (best-effort sync, fail-open writes).

Ownership & isolation: pi_* rows belong to neon_auth.user.id via user_id; pi_* tables use FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY scoped by app.current_user_id (runtime connection is non-owner fleet_pi_app). No DB FK from pi_* to neon_auth — identity stays private. Ownership probes use SECURITY DEFINER functions (fleet_pi_check_session_owner).

BYOK: pi_user_providers holds AES-GCM encrypted credentials (BETTER_AUTH_SECRET); encrypted_payload stores OCC/custom-instance metadata {displayName, baseUrl, api, modelIds}; auth_type CHECK apiKey|oauth.

Session hydration: browser refresh hydrates visible messages from pi_session_entries (raw_entry jsonb), using pi_sessions.leaf_entry_id/entry_count as cursors; version CHECK ≥ 3 guards the JSONL schema contract.

Provenance: pi_runs records one row per agent turn (status in_progress|completed|errored|aborted); pi_run_events is the ordered stream-event log (run_id, sequence); pi_tool_executions and pi_file_mutations are run-scoped with event_sequence/first_sequence anchors into that log.

Index patterns: pi_sessions(user_id, updated_at DESC) · pi_session_entries(session_id, entry_timestamp) · pi_runs(session_id, session_turn_index) · pi_run_events(run_id, sequence) · pi_tool_executions(run_id, first_sequence, last_sequence) · pi_file_mutations(canonical_path, recorded_at).

Also on disk: local dev mirrors the workspace tree to agent-workspace/indexes/workspace-projection.sqlite (workspace_items, provenance_runs, …) — separate from this Neon mirror; schema managed by pnpm chat:migrate. Neon Data API stays disabled; chat migrations revoke authenticated/anonymous grants on pi_* and EXECUTE on ownership probes — only fleet_pi_app may read/write.
